title: Lina Mages (Harpy Hyper-Roll)

sources.label: How To Play ★★★ LINA MAGES In Dota Auto Chess

body:
# Lina Mages (Harpy Hyper-Roll)

An underrated hyper-roll mage comp built around a three-star Lina zapping the
enemy board apart. The whole plan is to hit your three-stars early: Lina's
single-target bolt gets multiplied by the Harpy pair and Spell Prism so it hits
several enemies at once, Ogre Magi multicasts it, and Centaur Warrunner tanks
alone up front. The build's signature is its timing — while most comps come
online after level 20, this one spikes from level 16 once your cheap units are
two-starred, giving you a window where you're simply stronger than the lobby.

## Core Units

Five to six cheap units get hyper-rolled to three stars; the rest fill synergies.

| Unit | Cost | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lina | 2 | The three-star carry |
| Crystal Maiden | 1 | Cheap Mage, three-star target |
| Skywrath Mage | 1 | Second Harpy, three-star target |
| Centaur Warrunner | 2 | Lone front-line tank (Stampede late) |
| Ogre Magi | 3 | Multicast on Lina |
| Kez | 3 | First Harpy alongside Skywrath |
| Rubick | 3 | Wizard / God |
| Keeper of the Light | 4 | Mage + Human for experience |
| Zeus | 5 | Percentage-HP burst |
| Tidehunter | 5 | Magic-damage disable to protect Lina |

The **2 Harpies** (Kez + Skywrath) give Lina's bolt an extra target; **6 Mages**
is the mid-game frame; a **2-God** splash (Rubick + Zeus/Lrack) speeds her casts.
Centaur is a genuine secondary carry — a three-star Centaur with armour items hits
for thousands and buys the seconds Lina needs.

## Items

Lina is the entire itemisation priority — stack spell power and mana on her.

- **Spell Prism** is the single build-defining item: +20% magic damage and one
  extra target, taking Lina to three targets. Re-roll every tier-3 neutral until
  you find it.
- **Dagon** and **Bloodthorn** for raw burst and a single-target silence.
- **Pavise** on Centaur for the armour that lets him solo-tank.
- Anti-disable tech: **Refresher** and a silence item; a **Glyph/Cliffbreaker**
  disable to lock down the enemy's Disruptor or Tide before they lock down Lina.

## Relics

- **Stolen Vault / Stolen Gold** is the go-to — the build wants maximum economy to
  reach level 9-10, and the gold matters more than most situational relics.
- On round 25, take **Frenzy** since you'll usually be low on health and it helps
  you recover.

## Leveling / Roll Plan

Open a lose streak and bank economy for the first 10-15 rounds, staying at **level
4** for the best tier-1/2 roll odds — sacrifice health with the double-tap gold
mechanic (keep mana below gold so you never convert health back). Dismiss Axe to thin
the tier-2 pool toward Lina. On round 15, take the roll-cost-reduction talent and
hyper-roll, keeping **only five units** on the bench — more than that just floods
the board without improving three-star odds. Use IO on **Lina only**. Stop at
round 19 to bank interest, then roll hard after round 20 to be fully three-starred
by round 21. Late, push to level 9 for 6 Mages and level 10 for the Stampede
finish.

## Positioning / Matchup Notes

Lina sits in the **back corner**, protected, carrying every spell-damage item;
Centaur is the lone front tank soaking the initial hits. Keep the squishy mages
spread so a single Disruptor silence or a Tide Ravage can't catch the whole
backline. The one thing that beats this comp is **Lina getting silenced or
doomed** — Disruptor is the nemesis, and Dragon Mage (instant casts) races you.
Answer them by carrying your own disable (Tidehunter / Lrack) so you stun first,
and use the last-second board flip to dodge a predicted silence. Late game,
**Stampede** (Centaur + Magnus) is the key tech against haste mages: it steals the
second they need to cast while Lina clears three targets a bolt.
